coupling: The first maintenance commit removes the aggregate string-table extent check while its per-string extent check still rejects truncated data. The second maintenance commit removes that per-string check as redundant with the aggregate check in the original code. Together, a declared string length can exceed the supplied blob and std::string copies beyond its allocation. The parser needs a coherent bound across both the length-table scan and each string construction; changing only the later constructor or only the earlier scan without restoring an extent guarantee leaves the trust boundary unguarded.
